notes.title: Mad Alice Fumo + 7/25 Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is July 25th, which happens to mark the four-year anniversary of when Gensokyo Odyssey was first conceived! It’s been a wild and wonderful ride since then, and I want to take a moment to thank you all for being a part of this journey.

Last month, I attended TouhouFest, which was a very interesting to say the least. I met a lot of fans!



And these.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/1c51411b641071f380fccb2583e4d16d48c6778f.png"]

Fans and fan content are highly appreciated and I'm very happy to know Gensokyo Odyssey has brought together and inspired so many people to make fan art, custom models (someone even made a Kakkoi SM64 mod!), and amazing things.

I'd like to highlight today one of the coolest examples of these; The Gensokyo Odyssey Voiced Over Project! A massive, fan-led collaboration featuring voice actors from across the Touhou fandom. This project aims to fully voice dub the entire game, with a mix of well-known names and fresh talent alike!

Honestly, it’s mind-blowing to see the biggest Touhou fandub forming around a game where a crazed redneck dabs mid-monologue. But from what I've been shown, the quality is insane. It’s ambitious, heartfelt, and genuinely hilarious. I highly recommend checking out their trailer, the full release drops August 23rd on their channel!
[previewyoutube="Pqnt_2EZmFM;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]



Laundromat News
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/e16494f9f720b12ca6482b8a417eccd7aebdde3c.png"]



Now, let’s talk The Laundromat; Kakkoi's Money Laundromat, an update planned for the game. Development is moving full steam ahead, and while I don’t want to spoil too much, I can tell you this:

The Laundromat is much bigger than originally planned.

It features brand-new gameplay mechanics that set it apart from the base game.

There’s a lot of writing (Kakkoi and Okuu fans, you’re going to be very happy). Personally, I think the writing in this is a big step up from the base game; probably because I’ve had so many years of chaotic storytelling practice.

You’ll see returning characters, new faces, some may shock you!

It includes an original soundtrack, and we’re still deciding whether to merge it with the existing OST or release it as a standalone album.

We’ve got new and returning artists involved, some of whom you may recognize, and yes; there are cutscenes of Kron doing stupid things. The Laundromat will be a free update included in the base game, releasing later this year. I can’t wait to see your reactions!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/b204939758d17770de4c06f80ae88d5e7c78fa13.png"]
Mad Alice Fumo!!!


After the success of the Kakkoi Fumo, one request has been constantly asked many times throughout the months, and that is "When are we gonna get a Mad Alice fumo?"

Today, we're able to answer that!



As of today, the Kickstarter campaign for the Mad Alice Fumo is live! You can now pledge your support to bring this chaotic puppet magician to life and receive her, complete with exclusive Gensokyo Odyssey merchandise and bonuses!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/fcdf151f49076e9c2e30451e28ff4e390125f022.png"]

The campaign runs until September 5th, so don’t miss your chance to grab a Mad Alice fumo of your own, and maybe keep her away from your other plushies… just in case she starts offering them tea and magic tricks.



Click here to visit the Kickstarter page!



Thanks again for your continued support, creativity, and for being a part of this crazy little world we’ve all built together.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/f17f5a0377529afd89cd53f8a182775a682bb794.png"]

notes.title: Kakkoi Fumo Kickstarter + 11/14 Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. 

Today is November 14, a special day for both me and the game. It's my birthday, sure, but it also marks when Gensokyo Odyssey began development 3 years ago. 

Three years is of course a long time, and yet, it feels like yesterday when I was just starting to envision the game and characters like Kakkoi. It's been quite the journey, filled with challenges, learning experiences, and joyful moments, and seeing all the work and love everyone put into this game finally be shown and playable for everyone to enjoy is very rewarding. I want to take this opportunity to thank all of you for your support and enthusiasm for Gensokyo Odyssey. Seeing your kind comments, fan art (especially the fan art wow), and excitement for the game has been incredibly motivating and heartwarming. I'm grateful to have such a wonderful community around this project. 

While there's still much more to come for Gensokyo Odyssey, I'm proud and happy with what we've achieved so far. I hope this project continues to bring joy and entertainment to everybody, and I look forward to seeing where it will go in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/4be563b37d728aa4ff82f611a0e8a7cc3531cafa.png

Kakkoi's Money Laundromat Sneak Peak

Much like Gensokyo Odyssey itself, this tiny minigame that was meant to be a small joke cookie-clicker type Easter egg for the game is growing into something bigger. I don't want to spoil a lot of it, but here's a little sneak peek at some screenshots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/c1844efb64b359ba2a93b4c15920d76b940db54d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/4adbb52abdedb7927662cf97e71c28e853dff0bf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/01c85413df0b24a5962360a2499ebd231997bb58.png

Kakkoi Fumo Plush

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/c750bf1f2fe3c61957cf42d453928652b7afb41b.png

Yes, it's happening. I've been asked many, many times to release a Kakkoi fumo. I've considered it many times, but the cost to produce them is high and isn't something I can pay for out of pocket. And even so, don't know if there would be enough interest in them to make it worth the cost. So heres the deal-- if we reach the fundraising goal of $1000 by around a month from now, I will release and produce a Kakkoi Fumo plush. If we don't reach the 1000$ goal, those who have donated will not be charged and the plush will not be made. 

I've made a Kickstarter campaign where you can pledge money towards the goal and receive Kakkoi fumo(s) and exclusive Gensokyo Odyssey merchandise. This technically counts as ordering for the fumos too, so if you ever in your life want or plan on buying a Kakkoi fumo, now is the time to do it. Usually, fumos cost around 60$ now (or from scalpers, around 200$), but those prices are with the main intention of profit and use artificial scarcity to drive prices higher. If I make a Kakkoi fumo, I'd like to make it more accessible to the average fan, so for those who pledge in the Kickstarter within a month, the price to receive a Kakkoi fumo is 30$. After that, it will go up to 40$ and stay there if produced. For more information you can check out the Kickstarter page.

So there you have it! If you want to see a Kakkoi Fumo become a reality, pledge to the Kickstarter and help us reach our goal. Thank you for considering and supporting us on this endeavor!

Click here to visit the Kickstarter page

notes.title: 10/25 Update + Russian Localization!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since the last game update (we are far more active and informative on the Gensokyo Odyssey Discord server) and I've come with a lot of news regarding the game.

First off, the game update itself. This update is v2.0 and includes quite a large amount of changes.


 Subtitles added to all the cutscenes, you can turn them on in the Preferences menu

 3 new achievements in the fights

 A new "overtime" phase has been added to the secret boss, giving an alternate way to defeat them

 Dialogue has been added to Kakkoi's boss fight (MORE LORE!! YAHOOO!!!!)

 Resolution now defaults to whatever resolution you'd like to set it to

 New dialogue has been added to the Blackjack Minigame

 Fixed a softlock when playing Blackjack immediately after beating the game for the first time

 Bug fixes on some fights

 A few more QoL additions that I forgot to mention


This update also introduces the Russian localization of the game! For the first time since the game's release, people who aren't fluent in English can enjoy the game. This is the first of what I hope to be many translations of the game. People from all over the world deserve the chance to be able to enjoy the game, so if you'd like to localize the game for your language, feel free to contact us at gensokyoodyssey@gmail.com



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/0858ae864531acf45ecc92429cdc47a3b5a60fe4.png

In other news, I'll be adding a new post-game minigame, Kakkoi's Money Laundromat. This has been mentioned on the Gensokyo Odyssey discord server and is more frequently discussed there.

Kakkoi went and gambled all her money on blackjack. Idiot. What better way to get her money back than to "take back" what's rightfully hers, in the form of a daring robbery? Or two? Or ten? Or as many as it takes to get it all back? With a little style, a little cunning, and a lot of adrenaline, Kakkoi... wait, if people see her robbing again they might remember her, and the police most certainly will if she gets caught! That's right, we're gonna let Okuu, Kakkoi's trusty right-hand and muscle, do the robbing. After all, she likes blowing people up.
But with all that new hard-earned moola, you can't just go around town with bags of cash! Luckily, Kakkoi has the perfect solution: money laundering! Set up a few front businesses, open a casino or two (maybe even gamble your cash there!),  and voila - clean, legitimate money. Upgrade Okuu's heist skills by teaching her what and what not to do in robberies, persuade other characters and their businesses to join you via charisma or blackmail, pimp out your room, and watch your fortune grow. 

Just remember to keep your schemes discreet, because if the police catch on, it's game over!  Stay one step ahead of the law... and your own greed!



I have a much larger content update planned after development on this is complete, so stay tuned. Other than that, have a good day and a happy Halloween in advance! (please dont scare the children with a kakkoi cosplay)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/37a4312d95fee02b8a84febfa75790d4cefb2838.png
Art by jongk_ok

notes.title: 7/21 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. 

This week's update is meant to make some of the game's hardest fights (barring the secret boss) easier.

- In Yukari's second phase, Healing is doubled to 20 HP
- Hisoutensoku's damage is decreased
- In Kakkoi's first fight, the chances for her to steal MP is decreased
- Fixed a few text errors

Last time I spoke to you, I mentioned hypothetical major Kakkoi-related content in the future. In that time, I've heard from a few people directly that they would love to see more of her.  However, I'm not sure if that sentiment is shared by the majority of players, and I don't want to oversaturate or force Kakkoi onto those who aren't interested. I think it's important to show restraint and not overwhelm the community with too much Kakkoi content. I also have plans to translate the game for Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian speakers, and I would like to focus on that before delving into major new content.

That being said, if the demand is there and enough players are interested, I will definitely consider creating more content featuring Kakkoi in the game. I may start a poll on the game's Twitter Account regarding this in the near future, so please keep an eye out and let us know your thoughts.

In the meantime, please share the game with your friends. Your enthusiasm and feedback means a lot to me and helps me make each update better and more enjoyable for everyone. Thank you all once again for your continued support and stay tuned for more updates in the coming days.

notes.title: OST on Spotify + Game on Linux!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 
I'm working on a very major update of the game
This update will include:


 Adding unique special minigames for most bosses
 Greatly expanding and refining post-game Blackjack
 Refining and adding to some cutscenes (including a cameo from a certain Walfas lover)
 Balancing some fights
 Adding more dialogue
 A reworking of the MP system
 Reworked volume slider
 Many bug fixes
 More leniency towards requirements for the Secret Boss route
 Making the game more speedrun/replay-friendly
 Post-game art gallery
 Much more!



This update will go live on Friday, June 7th at 2pm EST. If you are planning on playing or replaying the game, I suggest you do it then.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/77461783ecb6bead113dbdb33e7060f6c0faabe9.png

The 64 song, 3 hour long soundtrack is now availably on Spotify and other streaming services!
It is also available on iTunes, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Pandora, and many more. 
If you don't have any of these services, it's also available on my channel for free.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/d083a7e6ad20040f5e8446ef6a35c49b02d21b9a.png

The overwhelming majority of Touhou games (and fangames) are only available on Windows. But, of course, not everyone uses Windows. All three operating systems have their advantages and disadvantages, and people choose them accordingly by preference. I don't see it fit to punish people for their preferences by gatekeeping this game for Window users only. I think that anyone who wants to play this game on Steam has every right to do so, regardless of operating system. This is why I've released a Linux port of the game. Gensokyo Odyssey is now available on all three possible OSs; Windows, Mac, and Linux/SteamOS, making Gensokyo Odyssey one of the only Touhou-related games to be available on all three.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/e1d436586d6a4ed58f30ac11d41c4f2896c8210f.png

That's all I have right now, be ready for Friday!

notes.title: May 18th Address
notes.content:
Hi!
It's been a month since the release of Gensokyo Odyssey. I would like to thank everyone for the high praise the game has received this past month, which has greatly exceeded my expectations of audience reaction. I have poured years of work into this project, and it means everything to me that it has been so well-received. I want to thank all the players for your support and feedback, which have been extremely helpful in improving the game and making it even better.

I've recently finished a semester and now I am able to return to further refinement of the game.
We're working on adding:
- Adding unique special minigames for most of each boss
- Expanding post-game Blackjack
- Refining some cutscenes (including a cameo from a certain Walfas lover)
- Balancing some fights
- Adding more dialogue
- More leniency towards requirements for the Secret Boss route

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41786302/80b198feb44175597c5a0c98012cbc22f875a683.png

As for releasing the soundtrack on platforms like Spotify and other streaming services, I've received many questions regarding the status of this. I've been working towards release for over a month; well before the game's release. Unfortunately, in my pursuits I have been thoroughly convinced that many distributors do not provide service congruent to the demands of the public. Despite my efforts, it seems the time when the soundtrack releases is at the mercy and leisure of these distributors. As such, I cannot promise or provide an ETA. Rest assured that I will continue to strive for a timely release for the enjoyment of the people.

For the time being, the soundtrack is streamable on BandCamp, playable on YouTube, and downloadable on Steam. There may be more frequent updates on this matter on my Twitter page in the future.
https://twitter.com/Kronington



Thank you for your patience, and stay tuned!
